description: This is a FastAPI router module defining endpoints related to billing, including creating checkout sessions, customer portals, and handling webhooks. It manages Stripe payment integrations, user authentication, and webhook verification.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user_payload(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and validates user info from the Bearer token in the Authorization header.

methods.name: _stripe_client()
methods.description: Configures and returns a Stripe SDK client based on environment settings.

methods.name: CheckoutSessionResponse create_checkout_session( data: CheckoutSessionRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for subscription purposes and returns the session URL.

methods.name: CustomerPortalResponse create_customer_portal( data: CustomerPortalRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Creates a Stripe billing portal session URL for managing billing settings.

methods.name: dict stripe_webhook(request: Request)
methods.description: Receives and verifies Stripe webhook events, handling signature verification if configured.

ctags.name: create_checkout_session
ctags.signature: ( data: CheckoutSessionRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )

ctags.name: create_customer_portal
ctags.signature: ( data: CustomerPortalRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
